_meta.title: Inpaint Remove v1
_meta.description: Remove a masked object and reconstruct plausible background underneath it. Same VAEEncodeForInpaint/KSampler backbone as inpaint-fill-v1.json, but the positive prompt is fixed to a generic 'seamless background' description instead of caller-supplied text — a removal should not need the caller to describe what appears, only where. Mask convention: white = remove, black = keep.
_meta.status: GPU-run verified 2026-09-02 on Apple M1 Pro/Metal (P-043) — loaded into a real ComfyUI and run to a saved image; checkpoint loading fixed from a nonexistent single-file name to UNETLoader+DualCLIPLoader+VAELoader, see workflows/README.md

2._note: Injected at runtime by the caller — see repaint_region.py.

3._note: Injected at runtime by the caller. White = object to remove.

6._note: Fixed, not caller-supplied — a removal fills with plausible surroundings, it doesn't need a subject description.
